children.name: Both Tracks
children.desc:
Enroll in Anthro 310G for Autumn, Winter, and Spring quarters.
Enroll in Anthro 441 Master’s Project in the final quarter of the MA degree program and earn a grade of B or better.

rules.name: THEORY REQUIREMENT
rules.desc: A minimum grade of 'B+' in one graduate-level ANTHRO Theory course from the chosen track is required.

rules.name: METHODS REQUIREMENT
rules.desc: A minimum grade of 'B+' in one graduate-level ANTHRO Methods course from the chosen track.

rules.name: ELECTIVES REQUIREMENT
rules.desc: Take at least 4 ANTHRO grad elective courses from the chosen track, listed at the 200-level or higher, taught by Anthropology faculty, and taken as a 5-unit course.

rules.name: Master's Paper
rules.desc:
Submit an approved laboratory research or library-based paper proposal by the last day of instruction in the first quarter of the master's degree program.
Both tracks are required to enroll in course Master’s Project in the final quarter of the MA degree program and earn a grade of B or better.
By Week 6 of Graduating Quarter, submit the Master's paper reviewed by two faculty members (advisor and reader).

• For the Culture and Society track, the paper can be a field research or library-based research paper.

• For the Archaeology track, the paper can also be a laboratory research paper.
Optional: Presentation of the master’s research project at the department’s Master’s (Honors) paper presentation event in spring quarter

rules.name: Recommended Course
rules.desc: Students are encouraged to enroll in ANTHRO 299 for Winter and Spring quarters.
